verdict.rationale: The documented Intelligent Commerce REST endpoints carry an explicit version segment (POST /acp/v1/instructions, /acp/v1/tokens, /acp/v1/instructions/{instructionID}/credentials), so versioned APIs are evidenced. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, and the product page warns it is still "in the process of development and deployment." missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, versioning or changelog guidance, independent corroboration of version stability
